open_points.subject: TrialExecution file-output disclosure class
open_points.text: M07 says a file output contains “only its facts — digest, size and media type, no bytes and never a StoredValue”, while State 4 says file outputs are recorded “each with the highest class of the case's inputs”.
open_points.question: Where is the disclosure class of a trial file output represented: as an additional fact in TrialExecution, or only derived from the trial case's inputs when read?
options: Add disclosure_class to each TrialExecution file-output fact
Do not store it; derive it from the case inputs when needed
open_points.default_guess: Do not store it; derive it from the trial case's inputs, because M07 defines the closed persisted facts and A07 already defines the derivation.
